name: Show No Mercy
aliases: Show No Mercy: NYC Slayer Tribute

evidence.note: Oct 3 'Big 4' tribute show at 89 North with Damage Inc and Chaotica, posted by the band.
Venue page bills a night of thrash metal with the band playing Reign in Blood in full.

dancing.notes: A thrash-metal tribute concert: fans headbang and may start a mosh pit, but there is no social or partner dancing.

description: Long-running New York City and Long Island Slayer tribute band; on Oct 3 it plays the yearly 'Big 4' thrash-metal tribute night at 89 North in Patchogue with Damage Inc. and Chaotica.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Confirmed Slayer tribute. Damage Inc. on the same bill is a Metallica tribute.

Directory research 2026-10-04: No official website or Instagram found; the Facebook page and YouTube channel are the band's official presence. Facebook confirmed indirectly (AllEvents pulls the organizer page and picture from facebook.com/ShowNoMercyNY); it could not be opened without logging in. Logo is the band's YouTube profile picture; note it is drawn over Slayer's eagle crest artwork and includes a pentagram, so the owner may prefer not to show it. No photos found outside Facebook. Current description is accurate (the Oct 3 show has passed).

evidence.note: YouTube channel "ShowNoMercy NY" describes itself as the official channel of Show No Mercy, NY's Slayer tribute.
AllEvents organizer page built from the Facebook page ShowNoMercyNY: "Show No Mercy: NYC Slayer Tribute", NYC/LI-based, longest-running four-piece Slayer tribute.
"The Big 4" thrash tribute night at 89 North, Patchogue, with Show No Mercy, Damage Inc. and Chaotica.
